details: Bitcoin surged by over 8% in the past 24 hours to approximately $77,864, marking its best five-day performance since March 2024. This rally gained momentum after US President Donald Trump met with crypto executives, urging Congress to pass the CLARITY Act. Further impetus came from macroeconomic policy changes, including the Secretary of the Treasury's announcement to double long-term bond buyback limits. Spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds also recorded significant single-day net inflows.
title: Trump's Crypto Support & US Treasury Actions Boost Bitcoin

details: The United Arab Emirates has suspended trade and financial transactions with Iran following a sharp increase in Gulf tensions. This move comes after UAE accusations of ballistic missiles from Iran threatening maritime traffic, which Tehran denies. The suspension affects trade, commercial exchanges, and financial transactions, raising concerns about regional security, shipping, and energy markets. For crypto investors, increased geopolitical uncertainty can lead to a reduction in risk assets, although Bitcoin's role as a decentralized asset might attract attention during financial instability.
sourceName: UAE Halts Trade With Iran: What the Gulf Crisis Means for Oil Prices, Bitcoin and Crypto
title: UAE Suspends Iran Trade, Raises Gulf Crisis Concerns

details: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP experienced significant drops, with $1.7 billion liquidated across the crypto market in the past 24 hours. The TOTAL3 market cap (excluding Bitcoin and Ethereum) fell by approximately 6.7%. This downturn is attributed to a lower geopolitical premium being priced into the market and the Federal Reserve's cautious approach to rate cuts, which could keep real yields elevated and pressure risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Crypto Market Crashes: $1.7B Liquidated as Fed Stance Shifts

details: Bitcoin has surged over 20% to $79,500, indicating a potential new bull market. This rally is supported by increased US Treasury debt buybacks, interpreted as a form of yield curve control, which is bullish for crypto and gold. Regulatory momentum is also building, with the White House hosting a crypto summit and agencies like the SEC and CFTC progressing on crypto rules. Institutional and retail investor alignment, alongside increased ETF inflows and Bitcoin treasury purchases, suggest sustained demand.
title: Bitcoin Breaks $79,500 on Treasury Buybacks & Regulatory Momentum
